title: harden convergio-graph — token extraction, query stability, store roundtrip
task_body: Tier-3 retrieval was occasionally flaky on edge-case queries (empty tokens, single-char tokens). Tighten the tokeniser, stabilise the query path, add roundtrip tests against the SQLite store, and refresh meta-edge handling in cargo_metadata.
rationale: tokens.rs owns extraction; query.rs the read path; store.rs the SQLite layer; meta.rs the cargo_metadata layer; the two tests pin the new behavior.
